description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of various models evaluated across three different metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical models, ordered from left to right as Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 0.9, with major numeric tick labels displayed from 0 to 0.8 at intervals of 0.2, alongside minor tick marks every 0.05. The chart features grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three side-by-side bars. According to the legend at the top, these bars represent "Sentiment Acc." in tan, "STS Corr." in reddish-brown, and "Paraphrase Acc." in teal, arranged in that order from left to right within each group. For the Single-task_baseline, Sentiment Acc. is approximately 0.53 (the tallest bar in this metric), STS Corr. is 0.50 (the shortest bar in this metric), and Paraphrase Acc. is 0.79 (the tallest bar in this metric). For Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, the values are roughly 0.52, 0.58, and 0.78, respectively. Unsupervised_SimCSE shows values of about 0.52, 0.71, and 0.77. Supervised_SimCSE has a Sentiment Acc. of approximately 0.49, an STS Corr. of 0.80, and a Paraphrase Acc. of 0.78. Finally, 2-Tier SimCSE records a Sentiment Acc. of roughly 0.49 (the shortest bar in this metric), an STS Corr. of 0.81 (the tallest bar in this metric), and a Paraphrase Acc. of 0.78. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow a strict alphabetical or numerical sorting order, and there are no visually emphasized bars through shading, bolding, or outlining.
